integrity.claim_basis: Analytic geometric cone reduction, attributed standard spherical-area formula, and sharp AM-GM arguments

scientific_limitations: Haar-oriented central sections of three-dimensional orthogonal boxes with strictly positive half-lengths only.
Known cube equal-edge probability is prior work; novelty lies in the complete unequal-aspect-ratio formula and sharp rigidity.
No uniqueness claim against unindexed earlier literature, oblique parallelotopes, or dimensions other than three.
Numerical experiments support but do not certify the analytic all-positive-input theorem.
title: Exact Haar hexagon law and cubic rigidity for central sections of rectangular boxes
